name: toy_oracle_standin
doc: The M1 encoding of the toy oracle machine, the baseline of I12-P1: no oracle sidecar, and each oracle compiled into the model as a stand-in builtin, exactly as spec/M1/lib/morph_rollup.lib.json compiles agg. The templates are the concrete instances of tests_m2/fixtures/oracles/lib/oracles.json (agg; dec under HypD-pad).
